login.title: Sign in
login.description: Enter your account name and password.

secondFactor.title: Second factor
secondFactor.description: Confirm it is you to finish signing in.

enroll.title: Create the first account
enroll.description: Paste the enrolment token printed in the dashboard logs, then choose the administrator account name and password (12 to 128 characters).

secondFactor.title: Add a second factor
secondFactor.description: Sign-in will require this second factor after your password.
secondFactor.totpIntro: Scan the QR code with an authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
secondFactor.qrLabel: QR code to scan with your authenticator app

recoveryCodes.title: Save your recovery codes
recoveryCodes.description: Each code can be used once if you lose your second factor. They are shown only now: store them somewhere safe.

errors.unauthenticated: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
errors.cross_origin: Request blocked: cross-origin requests are not allowed.
errors.invalid_target: The target must be a valid IP address or CIDR range.
errors.confirmation_required: Confirmation does not match the target.
errors.lapi_unavailable: The CrowdSec local API is unavailable.
errors.lapi_error: The CrowdSec local API returned an error.
errors.self_account: You cannot act on the dashboard's own account.
errors.self_ban: You cannot ban the address you are connected from. Ask another administrator or use cscli on the host.
errors.file_too_large: The file is too large to display.
errors.invalid_name: Use letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores (64 characters at most), starting with a letter or digit.
errors.invalid_account_name: The account name must be 1 to 64 characters: lowercase letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores, starting with a letter or digit.
errors.invalid_password_length: The password must be 12 to 128 characters long.
errors.database_unavailable: The database is unavailable. Please try again shortly.
errors.invalid_code: The code is incorrect or has expired.
errors.webauthn_failed: The security key could not be used.
errors.webauthn_unsupported: This browser does not support security keys. Use an authenticator app instead.
errors.webauthn_disabled: Security keys are not enabled on this server.
errors.second_factor_required: Confirm a second factor before continuing.
errors.second_factor_unavailable: The second factor service is unavailable. Please try again shortly.
errors.account_locked: This account is temporarily locked. Try again in {{minutes}} minute(s).
errors.pending_login_expired: Your sign-in attempt has expired. Please start again.
errors.second_factor_setup_not_allowed: A second factor cannot be set up from here. Contact an administrator.
errors.too_many_pending_logins: Too many sign-ins in progress. Please try again shortly.
errors.invalid_access_rule: Enter a valid IP address, CIDR or two-letter country code. Rules that match everything are refused.
errors.would_lock_out_current_client: Refused: this change would lock out your current connection. Add a rule that covers your address first.
errors.geolocation_unavailable: The GeoLite2 database is not available, so country rules cannot be managed right now.
errors.engine_exists: An engine with this name already exists.
errors.engine_local_readonly: The local engine is configured by the server and cannot be changed here.
errors.invalid_engine: The engine settings are invalid. Check the name, URLs and addresses; loopback, link-local and cloud metadata addresses are refused.
errors.engine_secret_required: Re-enter the machine password or the proxy credentials: the destination changed, so stored secrets are not reused.
errors.engine_unreachable: The engine could not be reached.
errors.engine_auth_failed: The engine refused the machine credentials.
errors.engine_blocked_address: The engine address is blocked by the network safety policy.
errors.engine_secret_unreadable: The stored secret of this engine cannot be decrypted. Re-enter it to restore collection.
errors.archive_write_failed: The collected alerts could not be written to the archive.
errors.registry_reload_failed: The change was saved, but the collector could not reload its engine list. The previous engine set stays active until the next successful reload.

decisions.unbanDescription: The decision {{id}} will be deleted and the target will no longer be blocked. Retype the address or range {{target}} below to confirm.

config.redactionNote: Values that look like secrets are redacted.

machines.addDescription: Registers a new machine and generates its password.
machines.selfDeleteReason: This is the dashboard's own account, protected against deletion.
machines.deleteDescription: The machine {{name}} will lose access to the CrowdSec local API.

hub.title: Hub
hub.caption: Hub items
hub.slowNote: Update and upgrade can take up to two minutes.
hub.installDescription: Installs a collection from the CrowdSec hub, for example crowdsecurity/linux.
hub.reloadHint: The hub changed. Reload CrowdSec for the changes to take effect.
hub.empty: No hub item matches these filters.

accountSecurity.title: Account security
accountSecurity.explanation: Access allowlist: with no rule, you can sign in from anywhere. As soon as a rule exists, every sign-in that matches none of the rules is refused. Rules are checked at sign-in only: sessions already open stay valid until they expire.
accountSecurity.geoNotice: Country rules require the GeoLite2 database to be available on the server; without it they cannot be added.
accountSecurity.emptyAllowsAll: No rule yet: sign-in is allowed from anywhere.
accountSecurity.valueLabel: IP address, CIDR or ISO country code
accountSecurity.deleteDescription: Sign-ins that only this rule allowed will be refused. The change is refused if it would lock out your current connection.
accountSecurity.deleteLastDescription: This is the last rule: deleting it turns the allowlist off and allows sign-in from anywhere.

engines.title: Engines
engines.description: CrowdSec engines whose alerts are archived by the dashboard.
engines.caption: Engines
engines.deleteDescription: Deleting the engine {{name}} also deletes its whole archive: alerts, events and decisions. To keep the archive, disable the engine instead.

fields.name: Name
fields.machinePasswordKeepHint: Leave empty to keep the stored password.
fields.proxyCredentialsHint: Write-only. Leave both empty to keep the stored credentials.
fields.proxyCredentialsRequired: Required: the proxy changed, re-enter both or clear the credentials.
fields.allowInsecureHttp: Allow plain HTTP to this engine
fields.publicAddressesHint: IP addresses or CIDR ranges, separated by commas or spaces.
